    displayColAction(SpaceObject) - Method in class Assessment
    Suggests a response based on the collision risk score: "Routine Monitoring" if score invalid input: '<' 0.05 "Periodic Checks" if 0.05 ≤ score invalid input: '<' 0.2 "Screening" if 0.2 ≤ score invalid input: '<' 1.0 "Detailed Analysis" if score ≥ 1.0
    displayOrbitAction(SpaceObject) - Method in class Assessment
    Suggests an action based on the orbit likelihood score: "Continue active monitoring" if score > 0.8 "Recheck or Update data" if 0.4 invalid input: '<' score ≤ 0.8 "Deorbited or Lost Track" if score ≤ 0.4
